description: This file contains database migration scripts for the Notesnook project, defining schema creation, updates, and index management using Kysely ORM, including FTS5 table setup and migration versioning.

classes.name: NNMigrationProvider
classes.description: Provides database migration implementations for the Notesnook project, managing schema creation and updates.

methods.name: getMigrations
methods.description: Returns a record of migration steps keyed by version string, defining schema changes and data transformations.

methods.name: addBaseColumns
methods.description: Adds common base columns to table schemas, such as id, type, dateModified, dateCreated, synced, and deleted.

methods.name: addTrashColumns
methods.description: Adds trash-related columns to table schemas, including dateDeleted, itemType, and deletedBy.

methods.name: createFTS5Table
methods.description: Creates a virtual FTS5 table with specified columns and options for full-text search indexing.

methods.name: runFTSTablesMigrations
methods.description: Drops existing FTS tables and recreates them with specific tokenizer configurations, then rebuilds the search index.
